I added a sleep between calls in `tests/test_payments.py`. I haven't run the test, because it's an integration test against the live sandbox.

- `test_charges_roundtrip` now waits `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL_S = 0.25` seconds after each POST. That's a little more than the 0.2 seconds per call that 5 requests per second allows, to leave some headroom.
- The constant is at the top of the file with a comment explaining it, so other tests can reuse it.

The limit applies to the whole sandbox, not just this test. If CI runs tests in parallel or other tests also call the sandbox, the combined rate can still go over 5 per second. If it still flakes, a shared throttle or retry-on-429 helper would hold up better.

I also saved a note in EngramDB that the sandbox is limited to 5 requests per second, so future tests that call it know to slow down.
